+def read_filename_list(path: str | None, nul: bool) -> list[str]:
+    if path is None:
+        raw = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
+    else:
+        with open(path, "rb") as handle:
+            raw = handle.read()
+    if not raw:
+        return []
+    separator = b"\x00" if nul else b"\n"
+    items = raw.split(separator)
+    if items and items[-1] == b"":
+        items = items[:-1]
+    return [item.decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape") for item in items]
+
+
+def format_size_table(value: int) -> str:
+    if value < 10240:
+        return f"{value} B"
+    units = ["KiB", "MiB", "GiB", "TiB", "PiB"]
+    scaled = float(value)
+    unit_index = -1
+    while scaled >= 10240.0 and unit_index + 1 < len(units) - 1:
+        scaled /= 1024.0
+        unit_index += 1
+    return f"{scaled:.1f} {units[unit_index]}"
+
+
+def format_size_verbose(value: int) -> str:
+    human = format_size_table(value)
+    if human.endswith(" B"):
+        return human
+    return f"{human} ({value} B)"
+
+
+def ratio_string_for_table(compressed: int, uncompressed: int) -> str:
+    if uncompressed == 0:
+        return "---"
+    ratio = compressed / uncompressed
+    if ratio > 9.999:
+        return "---"
+    return f"{ratio:.3f}"
+
+
+def ratio_string_for_verbose(compressed: int, uncompressed: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    if uncompressed == 0:
+        return ">", "9.999"
+    ratio = compressed / uncompressed
+    if ratio > 9.999:
+        return ">", "9.999"
+    return "=", f"{ratio:.3f}"
+
+
+def check_name_from_id(check_id: int) -> str:
+    return CHECK_NAMES.get(check_id, f"Check-{check_id}")
+
+
+def looks_like_lzma_alone(data: bytes) -> bool:
+    if len(data) < 13:
+        return False
+    prop = data[0]
+    if prop > (4 * 5 + 4) * 9 + 8:
+        return False
+    pb = prop // (9 * 5)
+    prop -= pb * 9 * 5
+    lp = prop // 9
+    lc = prop - lp * 9
+    if lc + lp > 4:
+        return False
+    size_field = int.from_bytes(data[5:13], "little")
+    if size_field != 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF and size_field >= (1 << 38):
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def decompress_xz(data: bytes, single_stream: bool) -> bytes:
+    if single_stream:
+        dec = lzma.LZMADecompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ)
+        try:
+            out = dec.decompress(data)
+        except lzma.LZMAError as exc:
+            raise CorruptDataError() from exc
+        if not dec.eof:
+            raise UnexpectedEndError()
+        return out
+
+    remaining = data
+    out_parts: list[bytes] = []
+    consumed = False
+    while True:
+        while len(remaining) >= 4 and remaining[:4] == b"\x00\x00\x00\x00":
+            remaining = remaining[4:]
+        if not remaining:
+            break
+        if not remaining.startswith(HEADER_MAGIC):
+            if consumed:
+                raise UnexpectedEndError()
+            raise FormatNotRecognizedError()
+        dec = lzma.LZMADecompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ)
+        try:
+            out_parts.append(dec.decompress(remaining))
+        except lzma.LZMAError as exc:
+            raise CorruptDataError() from exc
+        if not dec.eof:
+            raise UnexpectedEndError()
+        remaining = dec.unused_data
+        consumed = True
+    return b"".join(out_parts)
+
+
+def decompress_lzma_alone(data: bytes, single_stream: bool) -> bytes:
+    dec = lzma.LZMADecompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_ALONE)
+    try:
+        out = dec.decompress(data)
+    except lzma.LZMAError as exc:
+        raise CorruptDataError() from exc
+    if not dec.eof:
+        raise UnexpectedEndError()
+    if dec.unused_data and not single_stream:
+        raise CorruptDataError()
+    return out
+
+
+def decompress_payload(data: bytes, fmt: str, single_stream: bool) -> bytes:
+    if fmt == "xz":
+        return decompress_xz(data, single_stream)
+    if fmt == "lzma":
+        return decompress_lzma_alone(data, single_stream)
+    if fmt == "lzip":
+        raise FormatNotRecognizedError()
+    if fmt == "raw":
+        raise FormatNotRecognizedError()
+    if data.startswith(HEADER_MAGIC):
+        return decompress_xz(data, single_stream)
+    if looks_like_lzma_alone(data):
+        return decompress_lzma_alone(data, single_stream)
+    raise FormatNotRecognizedError()
+
+
+def parse_index(index: bytes) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
+    if len(index) < 8 or index[0] != 0:
+        raise CorruptDataError()
+    if crc32_bytes(index[:-4]) != index[-4:]:
+        raise CorruptDataError()
+    offset = 1
+    count, offset = decode_vli(index, offset)
+    records: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
+    for _ in range(count):
+        unpadded, offset = decode_vli(index, offset)
+        uncompressed, offset = decode_vli(index, offset)
+        records.append((unpadded, uncompressed))
+    if any(byte != 0 for byte in index[offset:-4]):
+        raise CorruptDataError()
+    return records
+
+
+def parse_single_block_xz(stream: bytes) -> ParsedSingleBlock:
+    if len(stream) < STREAM_HEADER_SIZE + STREAM_FOOTER_SIZE:
+        raise CorruptDataError()
+    footer = stream[-STREAM_FOOTER_SIZE:]
+    backward_size = struct.unpack("<I", footer[4:8])[0]
+    index_size = (backward_size + 1) * 4
+    index_start = len(stream) - STREAM_FOOTER_SIZE - index_size
+    index = stream[index_start : len(stream) - STREAM_FOOTER_SIZE]
+    records = parse_index(index)
+    stream_header = stream[:STREAM_HEADER_SIZE]
+    stream_flags = stream_header[6:8]
+    check_id = stream_flags[1] & 0x0F
+    check_size = CHECK_SIZES[check_id]
+    blocks: list[tuple[bytes, bytes, bytes, bytes, int]] = []
+    offset = STREAM_HEADER_SIZE
+    for unpadded_size, uncompressed_size in records:
+        header_size = (stream[offset] + 1) * 4
+        header = stream[offset : offset + header_size]
+        comp_size = unpadded_size - header_size - check_size
+        block_total = round_up4(unpadded_size)
+        comp_start = offset + header_size
+        comp_end = comp_start + comp_size
+        pad_end = offset + block_total - check_size
+        comp_data = stream[comp_start:comp_end]
+        pad = stream[comp_end:pad_end]
+        check = stream[pad_end : offset + block_total]
+        blocks.append((header, comp_data, pad, check, uncompressed_size))
+        offset += block_total
+    return ParsedSingleBlock(stream_header=stream_header, stream_flags=stream_flags, blocks=blocks)
+
+
+def extract_filter_flags(header: bytes) -> tuple[bytes, int]:
+    flags = header[1]
+    filter_count = (flags & 0x03) + 1
+    offset = 2
+    if flags & 0x40:
+        _, offset = decode_vli(header, offset)
+    if flags & 0x80:
+        _, offset = decode_vli(header, offset)
+    start = offset
+    for _ in range(filter_count):
+        _, offset = decode_vli(header, offset)
+        prop_size, offset = decode_vli(header, offset)
+        offset += prop_size
+    return header[start:offset], filter_count
+
+
+def decode_lzma2_dict_size(filter_flags: bytes) -> int:
+    prop = filter_flags[-1] & 0x3F
+    if prop == 40:
+        return 0xFFFFFFFF
+    return (2 | (prop & 1)) << (prop // 2 + 11)
+
+
+def transform_block_for_mt(header: bytes, comp_data: bytes, pad: bytes, check: bytes, uncompressed_size: int) -> tuple[bytes, int]:
+    filter_flags, filter_count = extract_filter_flags(header)
+    header_without_crc = bytearray()
+    header_without_crc.append(0)
+    header_without_crc.append(0xC0 | ((filter_count - 1) & 0x03))
+    header_without_crc += encode_vli(len(comp_data))
+    header_without_crc += encode_vli(uncompressed_size)
+    header_without_crc += filter_flags
+    target = max(16, round_up4(len(header_without_crc)))
+    header_without_crc += b"\x00" * (target - len(header_without_crc))
+    header_without_crc[0] = ((len(header_without_crc) + 4) // 4) - 1
+    new_header = bytes(header_without_crc) + crc32_bytes(header_without_crc)
+    unpadded_size = len(new_header) + len(comp_data) + len(check)
+    return new_header + comp_data + pad + check, unpadded_size
+
+
+def build_mt_like_xz(data: bytes, preset: int, check_name: str, block_size: int | None) -> bytes:
+    check_id, check_const = CHECK_IDS[check_name]
+    preset_value = preset
+    if data == b"":
+        return lzma.compress(data, format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ, preset=preset_value, check=check_const)
+    single_stream = lzma.compress(data, format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ, preset=preset_value, check=check_const)
+    parsed_single = parse_single_block_xz(single_stream)
+    if not parsed_single.blocks:
+        return single_stream
+    first_filter_flags, _ = extract_filter_flags(parsed_single.blocks[0][0])
+    dict_size = decode_lzma2_dict_size(first_filter_flags)
+    chunk_size = block_size if block_size is not None else max(1024 * 1024, dict_size * 3)
+
+    chunks = [data[index : index + chunk_size] for index in range(0, len(data), chunk_size)]
+    if not chunks:
+        chunks = [b""]
+
+    header_stream = lzma.compress(chunks[0], format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ, preset=preset_value, check=check_const)
+    header_parts = parse_single_block_xz(header_stream)
+    stream_header = header_parts.stream_header
+    stream_flags = header_parts.stream_flags
+
+    transformed_blocks: list[tuple[bytes, int, int]] = []
+    for chunk in chunks:
+        encoded = lzma.compress(chunk, format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ, preset=preset_value, check=check_const)
+        parsed = parse_single_block_xz(encoded)
+        for header, comp_data, pad, check, uncompressed_size in parsed.blocks:
+            block, unpadded_size = transform_block_for_mt(header, comp_data, pad, check, uncompressed_size)
+            transformed_blocks.append((block, unpadded_size, uncompressed_size))
+
+    if not transformed_blocks:
+        return lzma.compress(b"", format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ, preset=preset_value, check=check_const)
+
+    body = bytearray(stream_header)
+    index_without_crc = bytearray(b"\x00")
+    index_without_crc += encode_vli(len(transformed_blocks))
+    for block, unpadded_size, uncompressed_size in transformed_blocks:
+        body += block
+        index_without_crc += encode_vli(unpadded_size)
+        index_without_crc += encode_vli(uncompressed_size)
+    index_without_crc += b"\x00" * ((-len(index_without_crc)) % 4)
+    index = bytes(index_without_crc) + crc32_bytes(index_without_crc)
+    footer_fields = le32(len(index) // 4 - 1) + stream_flags
+    footer = crc32_bytes(footer_fields) + footer_fields + FOOTER_MAGIC
+    body += index
+    body += footer
+    return bytes(body)
+
+
+def compress_payload(data: bytes, cfg: Config) -> bytes:
+    preset_value = cfg.preset | (lzma.PRESET_EXTREME if cfg.extreme else 0)
+    fmt = cfg.fmt if cfg.fmt != "auto" else "xz"
+    if fmt == "lzip":
+        raise XZAppError("Compression of lzip files (.lz) is not supported")
+    if fmt == "raw":
+        raise XZAppError("Compression to the raw format is not supported")
+    if fmt == "lzma":
+        return lzma.compress(data, format=lzma.FORMAT_ALONE, preset=preset_value)
+    check_name = cfg.check_name or "crc64"
+    if cfg.threads == 1:
+        _, check_const = CHECK_IDS[check_name]
+        return lzma.compress(data, format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ, preset=preset_value, check=check_const)
+    return build_mt_like_xz(data, preset_value, check_name, cfg.block_size)
+
+
+def parse_xz_listing(data: bytes) -> ParsedXZ:
+    if not data.startswith(HEADER_MAGIC):
+        raise FormatNotRecognizedError()
+    end = len(data)
+    streams_rev: list[StreamRecord] = []
+    while end > 0:
+        padding = 0
+        while end - padding - 1 >= 0 and data[end - padding - 1] == 0:
+            padding += 1
+        if padding and padding % 4 != 0:
+            raise CorruptDataError()
+        end -= padding
+        if end == 0:
+            break
+        if end < STREAM_FOOTER_SIZE:
+            raise CorruptDataError()
+        footer_start = end - STREAM_FOOTER_SIZE
+        footer = data[footer_start:end]
+        if footer[-2:] != FOOTER_MAGIC:
+            raise CorruptDataError()
+        footer_fields = footer[4:10]
+        if crc32_bytes(footer_fields) != footer[:4]:
+            raise CorruptDataError()
+        index_size = (struct.unpack("<I", footer[4:8])[0] + 1) * 4
+        index_start = footer_start - index_size
+        if index_start < 0:
+            raise CorruptDataError()
+        index = data[index_start:footer_start]
+        records = parse_index(index)
+        blocks_total = sum(round_up4(unpadded_size) for unpadded_size, _ in records)
+        stream_start = index_start - STREAM_HEADER_SIZE - blocks_total
+        if stream_start < 0:
+            raise CorruptDataError()
+        stream_header = data[stream_start : stream_start + STREAM_HEADER_SIZE]
+        if stream_header[:6] != HEADER_MAGIC:
+            raise CorruptDataError()
+        if stream_header[6:8] != footer[8:10]:
+            raise CorruptDataError()
+        if crc32_bytes(stream_header[6:8]) != stream_header[8:12]:
+            raise CorruptDataError()
+        check_id = stream_header[7] & 0x0F
+        check_name = check_name_from_id(check_id)
+        blocks: list[BlockRecord] = []
+        comp_offset = stream_start + STREAM_HEADER_SIZE
+        uncomp_offset = 0
+        for unpadded_size, uncompressed_size in records:
+            total_size = round_up4(unpadded_size)
+            blocks.append(
+                BlockRecord(
+                    unpadded_size=unpadded_size,
+                    uncompressed_size=uncompressed_size,
+                    total_size=total_size,
+                    comp_offset=comp_offset,
+                    uncomp_offset=uncomp_offset,
+                )
+            )
+            comp_offset += total_size
+            uncomp_offset += uncompressed_size
+        streams_rev.append(
+            StreamRecord(
+                start=stream_start,
+                compressed_size=end - stream_start,
+                uncompressed_size=sum(uncompressed for _, uncompressed in records),
+                check_name=check_name,
+                padding=padding,
+                blocks=blocks,
+            )
+        )
+        end = stream_start
+    if not streams_rev:
+        raise FormatNotRecognizedError()
+    return ParsedXZ(streams=list(reversed(streams_rev)))
+
+
+def write_output_file(path: str, data: bytes, input_stat: os.stat_result | None, cfg: Config) -> None:
+    target = Path(path)
+    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=str(target.parent), delete=False) as handle:
+        temp_name = handle.name
+        handle.write(data)
+    if input_stat is not None:
+        try:
+            os.chmod(temp_name, stat.S_IMODE(input_stat.st_mode))
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    os.replace(temp_name, path)
+
+
+def derive_compress_output_path(path: str, cfg: Config) -> str | None:
+    fmt = cfg.fmt if cfg.fmt != "auto" else "xz"
+    suffix = cfg.suffix
+    if suffix is None:
+        suffix = ".lzma" if fmt == "lzma" else ".xz"
+    if path.endswith(suffix):
+        return None
+    return path + suffix
+
+
+def derive_decompress_output_path(path: str, cfg: Config) -> str | None:
+    if cfg.suffix is not None:
+        if not path.endswith(cfg.suffix):
+            return None
+        return path[: -len(cfg.suffix)]
+    for suffix, replacement in KNOWN_DECOMPRESS_SUFFIXES:
+        if path.endswith(suffix):
+            return path[: -len(suffix)] + replacement
+    return None
+
+
+def input_label(path: str) -> str:
+    return "(stdin)" if path == "-" else path
+
+
+def read_input_file(path: str) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result | None]:
+    if path == "-":
+        return sys.stdin.buffer.read(), None
+    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
+        data = handle.read()
+    return data, os.stat(path, follow_symlinks=False)
+
+
+def should_skip_link(path: str, cfg: Config) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+    if cfg.force or path == "-":
+        return False, None
+    st = os.lstat(path)
+    if stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode):
+        return True, "Is a symbolic link, skipping"
+    if st.st_nlink > 1:
+        return True, "Input file has more than one hard link, skipping"
+    return False, None
+
+
+def maybe_remove_input(path: str, cfg: Config) -> None:
+    if path == "-" or cfg.keep or cfg.stdout:
+        return
+    os.unlink(path)
+
+
+def format_status_line(name: str, compressed: int, uncompressed: int) -> str:
+    relation, ratio = ratio_string_for_verbose(compressed, uncompressed)
+    return (
+        f"{name}: {format_size_table(compressed)} / {format_size_table(uncompressed)} "
+        f"{relation} {ratio}"
+    )
+
+
+def print_list_basic(rows: list[tuple[int, int, int, int, str, str]], status: RunStatus) -> None:
+    if not rows:
+        return
+    emit_line(
+        sys.stdout.buffer,
+        "Strms  Blocks   Compressed Uncompressed  Ratio  Check   Filename\n",
+    )
+    for streams, blocks, compressed, uncompressed, check_name, filename in rows:
+        emit_line(
+            sys.stdout.buffer,
+            f"{streams:5d} {blocks:7d} {format_size_table(compressed):>12} "
+            f"{format_size_table(uncompressed):>12} {ratio_string_for_table(compressed, uncompressed):>6}  "
+            f"{check_name:<7} {filename}\n",
+        )
+    if len(rows) > 1:
+        total_streams = sum(item[0] for item in rows)
+        total_blocks = sum(item[1] for item in rows)
+        total_compressed = sum(item[2] for item in rows)
+        total_uncompressed = sum(item[3] for item in rows)
+        checks = {item[4] for item in rows}
+        check_name = next(iter(checks)) if len(checks) == 1 else "Mixed"
+        emit_line(sys.stdout.buffer, f"{STREAM_SEPARATOR}\n")
+        emit_line(
+            sys.stdout.buffer,
+            f"{total_streams:5d} {total_blocks:7d} {format_size_table(total_compressed):>12} "
+            f"{format_size_table(total_uncompressed):>12} {ratio_string_for_table(total_compressed, total_uncompressed):>6}  "
+            f"{check_name:<7} {len(rows)} files\n",
+        )
+
+
+def print_list_verbose(name: str, index: int, total: int, parsed: ParsedXZ) -> None:
+    emit_line(sys.stdout.buffer, f"{name} ({index}/{total})\n")
+    emit_line(sys.stdout.buffer, f"  Streams:           {parsed.stream_count}\n")
+    emit_line(sys.stdout.buffer, f"  Blocks:            {parsed.block_count}\n")
+    emit_line(
+        sys.stdout.buffer,
+        f"  Compressed size:   {format_size_verbose(parsed.compressed_size)}\n",
+    )
+    emit_line(
+        sys.stdout.buffer,
+        f"  Uncompressed size: {format_size_verbose(parsed.uncompressed_size)}\n",
+    )
+    emit_line(
+        sys.stdout.buffer,
+        f"  Ratio:             {ratio_string_for_table(parsed.compressed_size, parsed.uncompressed_size)}\n",
+    )
+    emit_line(sys.stdout.buffer, f"  Check:             {parsed.check_name}\n")
+    emit_line(
+        sys.stdout.buffer,
+        f"  Stream Padding:    {format_size_verbose(parsed.total_padding)}\n",
+    )
+    emit_line(sys.stdout.buffer, "  Streams:\n")
+    emit_line(
+        sys.stdout.buffer,
+        "    Stream    Blocks      CompOffset    UncompOffset        CompSize      "
+        "UncompSize  Ratio  Check      Padding\n",
+    )
+    uncomp_base = 0
+    for stream_index, stream in enumerate(parsed.streams, start=1):
+        emit_line(
+            sys.stdout.buffer,
+            f"{stream_index:10d}{len(stream.blocks):10d}{stream.start:16d}{uncomp_base:16d}"
+            f"{stream.compressed_size:16d}{stream.uncompressed_size:16d}"
+            f"{ratio_string_for_table(stream.compressed_size, stream.uncompressed_size):>7}  "
+            f"{stream.check_name:<7} {stream.padding:12d}\n",
+        )
+        uncomp_base += stream.uncompressed_size
+    emit_line(sys.stdout.buffer, "  Blocks:\n")
+    emit_line(
+        sys.stdout.buffer,
+        "    Stream     Block      CompOffset    UncompOffset       TotalSize      "
+        "UncompSize  Ratio  Check\n",
+    )
+    for stream_index, stream in enumerate(parsed.streams, start=1):
+        for block_index, block in enumerate(stream.blocks, start=1):
+            emit_line(
+                sys.stdout.buffer,
+                f"{stream_index:10d}{block_index:10d}{block.comp_offset:16d}{block.uncomp_offset:16d}"
+                f"{block.total_size:16d}{block.uncompressed_size:16d}"
+                f"{ratio_string_for_table(block.total_size, block.uncompressed_size):>7}  "
+                f"{stream.check_name}\n",
+            )
+
+
+def process_compress_file(cfg: Config, status: RunStatus, path: str) -> None:
+    label = input_label(path)
+    if path != "-":
+        try:
+            skip, reason = should_skip_link(path, cfg)
+        except OSError as exc:
+            print_error(cfg, status, f"{path}: {exc.strerror}")
+            return
+        if skip:
+            print_warning(cfg, status, f"{path}: {reason}")
+            return
+    try:
+        data, input_stat = read_input_file(path)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        print_error(cfg, status, f"{label}: {exc.strerror}")
+        return
+    try:
+        output = compress_payload(data, cfg)
+    except XZAppError as exc:
+        print_error(cfg, status, str(exc))
+        return
+
+    if path == "-" or cfg.stdout:
+        sys.stdout.buffer.write(output)
+    else:
+        out_path = derive_compress_output_path(path, cfg)
+        if out_path is None:
+            suffix = cfg.suffix if cfg.suffix is not None else (".lzma" if (cfg.fmt if cfg.fmt != "auto" else "xz") == "lzma" else ".xz")
+            print_warning(cfg, status, f"{path}: File already has '{suffix}' suffix, skipping")
+            return
+        if os.path.lexists(out_path) and not cfg.force:
+            print_error(cfg, status, f"{out_path}: File exists")
+            return
+        try:
+            write_output_file(out_path, output, input_stat, cfg)
+            maybe_remove_input(path, cfg)
+        except OSError as exc:
+            print_error(cfg, status, f"{out_path}: {exc.strerror}")
+            return
+
+    if cfg.verbose:
+        emit_line(sys.stderr.buffer, f"{format_status_line(label, len(output), len(data))}\n")
+
+
+def process_decompress_file(cfg: Config, status: RunStatus, path: str) -> None:
+    label = input_label(path)
+    out_path: str | None = None
+    if path != "-" and not cfg.stdout:
+        try:
+            skip, reason = should_skip_link(path, cfg)
+        except OSError as exc:
+            print_error(cfg, status, f"{path}: {exc.strerror}")
+            return
+        if skip:
+            print_warning(cfg, status, f"{path}: {reason}")
+            return
+        out_path = derive_decompress_output_path(path, cfg)
+        if out_path is None:
+            print_warning(cfg, status, f"{path}: Filename has an unknown suffix, skipping")
+            return
+        if os.path.lexists(out_path) and not cfg.force:
+            print_error(cfg, status, f"{out_path}: File exists")
+            return
+
+    try:
+        data, input_stat = read_input_file(path)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        print_error(cfg, status, f"{label}: {exc.strerror}")
+        return
+
+    try:
+        output = decompress_payload(data, cfg.fmt, cfg.single_stream)
+    except FormatNotRecognizedError:
+        print_error(cfg, status, f"{label}: File format not recognized")
+        return
+    except CorruptDataError:
+        print_error(cfg, status, f"{label}: Compressed data is corrupt")
+        return
+    except UnexpectedEndError:
+        print_error(cfg, status, f"{label}: Unexpected end of input")
+        return
+
+    if cfg.operation == "test":
+        if cfg.verbose:
+            emit_line(sys.stderr.buffer, f"{format_status_line(label, len(data), len(output))}\n")
+        return
+
+    if path == "-" or cfg.stdout:
+        sys.stdout.buffer.write(output)
+    else:
+        try:
+            write_output_file(out_path, output, input_stat, cfg)
+            maybe_remove_input(path, cfg)
+        except OSError as exc:
+            print_error(cfg, status, f"{out_path}: {exc.strerror}")
+            return
+
+    if cfg.verbose:
+        emit_line(sys.stderr.buffer, f"{format_status_line(label, len(data), len(output))}\n")
+
+
+def process_list_files(cfg: Config, status: RunStatus, files: list[str]) -> None:
+    rows: list[tuple[int, int, int, int, str, str]] = []
+    for index, path in enumerate(files, start=1):
+        if path == "-":
+            print_error(cfg, status, "--list does not support reading from standard input")
+            continue
+        try:
+            with open(path, "rb") as handle:
+                data = handle.read()
+        except OSError as exc:
+            print_error(cfg, status, f"{path}: {exc.strerror}")
+            continue
+        try:
+            parsed = parse_xz_listing(data)
+        except FormatNotRecognizedError:
+            print_error(cfg, status, f"{path}: File format not recognized")
+            continue
+        except CorruptDataError:
+            print_error(cfg, status, f"{path}: Compressed data is corrupt")
+            continue
+        if cfg.verbose:
+            print_list_verbose(path, index, len(files), parsed)
+        rows.append(
+            (
+                parsed.stream_count,
+                parsed.block_count,
+                parsed.compressed_size,
+                parsed.uncompressed_size,
+                parsed.check_name,
+                path,
+            )
+        )
+    if not cfg.verbose:
+        print_list_basic(rows, status)
+
+
+def collect_files(cfg: Config) -> list[str]:
+    files = list(cfg.files)

+
+
+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
+    cfg, exit_code = parse_args(argv)
+    if cfg is None:
+        return 1 if exit_code is None else exit_code
+    if cfg.special_action == "help":

+    if cfg.special_action == "long-help":
+        print_long_help(cfg.program)
+        return 0
+    if cfg.special_action == "version":
+        print_version(cfg.robot)
+        return 0
+    if cfg.special_action == "info-memory":
+        print_info_memory()
+        return 0

+    files = collect_files(cfg)
+    status = RunStatus()
+
+    if cfg.operation == "list":
+        process_list_files(cfg, status, files)

+
+    for path in files:
+        if cfg.operation == "compress":
+            process_compress_file(cfg, status, path)
+        else:
+            process_decompress_file(cfg, status, path)

+    return status.exit_code(cfg.no_warn)
+
+

+    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))

def norm_tree(files, root):
    out={}
    for k,v in files.items():
        if v[0]=='symlink':
            out[k]=('symlink', v[1].replace(str(root), '<ROOT>'))
        else:
            out[k]=v
    return out

def run_case(target, setup, argv, stdin_data, alias):
    cwd = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir='/workspace'))
    (cwd/alias).symlink_to(target)
    setup(cwd)
    if callable(stdin_data):
        stdin_bytes = stdin_data(cwd)
    else:
        stdin_bytes = stdin_data
    cp = subprocess.run([str(cwd/alias), *argv], cwd=cwd, input=stdin_bytes, capture_output=True)
    files = {}
    for path in sorted(cwd.rglob('*')):
        if path.name == alias:
            continue
        rel = path.relative_to(cwd).as_posix()
        if path.is_symlink():
            files[rel] = ('symlink', os.readlink(path))
        elif path.is_file():
            files[rel] = ('file', path.read_bytes())
        elif path.is_dir():
            files[rel] = ('dir', None)
    return cwd, cp.returncode, cp.stdout, cp.stderr, files

failures=[]
for name, setup, argv, stdin_data, alias in cases:
    cwd1, rc1, out1, err1, files1 = run_case(orig, setup, argv, stdin_data, alias)
    cwd2, rc2, out2, err2, files2 = run_case(clone, setup, argv, stdin_data, alias)
    n1=(rc1, out1.replace(str(cwd1).encode(), b'<ROOT>'), err1.replace(str(cwd1).encode(), b'<ROOT>'), norm_tree(files1,cwd1))
    n2=(rc2, out2.replace(str(cwd2).encode(), b'<ROOT>'), err2.replace(str(cwd2).encode(), b'<ROOT>'), norm_tree(files2,cwd2))
    if n1!=n2:
        failures.append(name)
        print('CASE', name)
        print('rc', rc1, rc2)
        if n1[1]!=n2[1]:
            print('orig stdout', n1[1].decode('utf-8','replace'))
            print('clone stdout', n2[1].decode('utf-8','replace'))
        if n1[2]!=n2[2]:
            print('orig stderr', n1[2].decode('utf-8','replace'))
            print('clone stderr', n2[2].decode('utf-8','replace'))
        if n1[3]!=n2[3]:

            print('clone files', {k:(v[0], len(v[1]) if isinstance(v[1], (bytes, bytearray)) else v[1]) for k,v in n2[3].items()})
        print()
    shutil.rmtree(cwd1); shutil.rmtree(cwd2)
print('FAILURES', failures)
